item.title: Frontier
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Frontier
  • 発売日: 1995-08-25
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: フロンティア
  • 英語名: Frontier

あらすじ

A collection of three stories:

  1. 遠雷ワイバーン is about a bounty hunter who stays at the inn and is requested to rescue a kidnapped girl.

  2. 快感空間「愛」is about a couple who get summoned to another world one day. The goddess there gives a test to make love to three her maids.

  3. “Blood line” is about a an adult store owner Eleanor who supplies space ships with sex dolls. She learns about a suspicious disappearance of a space ship that is rumored to be hijacked by a terrorist group. It’s a multi-site adventure that shows another point of view after initial playthrough.
